job_title: IT Intern - Universal Operations and Technology
description_text: Company Description NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information. Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world. NBCUniversal’s Operations & Technology (O&T) group is the shared services organization that provides the company with a broad portfolio of services and capabilities including media and studio operations, international operations, real estate, infrastructure, security and technology. The O&T group provides global support to NBCUniversal with a 2000+ strong workforce and is a critical to the growth and success of the company. Job Description Role Overview The IT Intern will play a key role in supporting the TechEx team's daily operations, focusing on maintaining and enhancing the efficiency of technical processes and project activities across both the Sydney office and the broader teams in Australia and Singapore. The intern will gain valuable hands-on experience in technical support, asset management, and workflow automation, with opportunities to contribute to team projects and IT initiatives on a regional level. Key Responsibilities Technical Support Shadow the TechEx Team: Work alongside the TechEx team to gain firsthand experience in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues, learning best practices in customer service and problem-solving. AV Equipment Setup: Assist in setting up and testing audiovisual (AV) equipment in meeting rooms and event spaces. Ensure that all devices are properly configured and functioning ahead of any scheduled meetings or presentations. Issue Resolution: Actively engage with the team to address technical challenges as they arise, contributing to quick resolutions and documenting solutions for future reference. Meeting Room Management Regular Inspections: Conduct routine checks of the six meeting rooms in the Sydney office to verify that all AV equipment, cables, TVs, and other technical assets are in good working order. Reporting and Troubleshooting: Document any issues encountered during inspections and coordinate with relevant team members to ensure timely repairs or replacements. Optimization: Recommend improvements or upgrades to the meeting room setups to enhance functionality and user experience. Power Automate and Workflow Assistance Workflow Development: Collaborate with the team to design, develop, and refine automated workflows using Power Automate, enhancing efficiency in day-to-day operations. Documentation and Guides: Create and update comprehensive guides and documentation to help team members understand and utilize automated workflows effectively. Team Communication: Keep the entire team informed about updates and changes to workflows, ensuring smooth adoption and integration of new processes. Team Project Activities Project Support: Participate in the planning, coordination, and execution of team projects, providing administrative and logistical support to ensure milestones are met on time. Documentation Management: Create and manage project-related documents, including project scopes, timelines, progress reports, and meeting minutes. Task Coordination: Work closely with project leaders to track action items, follow up on task assignments, and facilitate communication between team members. Asset Management and Governance Asset Lifecycle Management: Oversee the entire lifecycle of IT assets, from deployment to disposal, ensuring accurate records are maintained at all stages. Inventory Audits: Conduct regular audits of asset inventory, comparing physical stock against records in ServiceNow to identify discrepancies or missing items. Device Wiping and Tracking: Assist in securely wiping devices returned from users, ensuring they are clean and ready for re-deployment or disposal. Maintain detailed records of asset status and location.
